summary: Paying for the first year comes down to two kinds of money: what is repaid and what is not.
realLife: Grants and loans are the main federal aid for first-time, full-time undergraduates; loans typically have to be repaid and grants do not.
inGame: the people module's life records, read by lifeOf in src/bench/loading.ts (school/college-started). needs: a student loan record opened at the start.
